Pool per-donor ABC particles into a mechanistic reference bank

Source: R/bank.R
mbmm_pool_bank.Rd

Constructs a balanced mechanistic reference bank by retaining the same number of accepted ABC particles from every eligible donor.

Usage

mbmm_pool_bank(
  particles,
  n_per_donor = NULL,
  donor_col = "id",
  eligible_donors = NULL,
  allow_fewer = FALSE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

particles

A data.frame containing accepted ABC particles, with one row per particle.

n_per_donor

Number of particles to retain per donor. If NULL, uses the minimum available count across eligible donors.

donor_col

Name of the donor ID column.

eligible_donors

Optional vector of donor IDs to include. This can be used for application-specific eligibility rules, such as requiring a minimum number of detected measurements.

allow_fewer

If FALSE, stop when a donor has fewer particles than n_per_donor. If TRUE, retain all available particles for that donor.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A pooled particle bank with a balanced donor contribution when allow_fewer = FALSE.

Details

When n_per_donor = NULL, the smallest available donor-specific particle count is used, so that every donor contributes equally.

If n_per_donor is supplied and some donor has fewer particles than requested, the default behavior is to stop rather than silently construct an unbalanced bank. Set allow_fewer = TRUE only when unequal donor-specific particle counts are intentional.
